question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` wrap every option set larger than four by default, or should wrapping be an explicit call-site policy used by Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can be technically correct, but this PR changes the behavior contract of a shared Android design-system component and repository evidence does not establish which UX policy the Android owner intends.

options.title: Accept shared wrapping
options.body: Treat readable balanced rows for more than four options as the shared component default and proceed after refreshing the branch and checks.

options.title: Make wrapping explicit
options.body: Preserve the current shared one-row contract and add a narrow layout parameter or separate wrapping component for Skill Workshop and other opted-in callers.

recommendation.title: Accept shared wrapping
recommendation.body: Treat readable balanced rows for more than four options as the shared component default and proceed after refreshing the branch and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README explicitly identifies obviyus as the Android app owner, and this is a shared Android UI contract choice.
